datePolicy: Localization date 2026-11-06 is not a source refresh or publication date. Every source retains its recorded 2026-11-06 scenario/research timezone access date. Original requests were made 2026-11-05 UTC, also November 5 in Vancouver. Advertisement seen dates use the original research convention, not a Vancouver next-day inspection. No external re-research performed.
uncertainties: 2026 full-year BC tax model is a proxy only, not verified 2027 payroll. Spouse credits, RRSP, workplace pension/benefits, part-year newcomer and foreign-income effects are not resolved; child benefits are excluded.

All 12 ads are unauthenticated Craigslist advertisements, not representative market evidence or verified management inventory; no May 2027 home, landlord authority, family acceptance or vacancy confirmed. Sizes, utilities and station walks are advertiser claims.

Listing discrepancies retained: Silver Ave/Street, Magnolia December-special ordinary rent unknown, Carnarvon availability/Christmas copy, Nelsons first-12-month incentive and extra costs, Hub Two 802/809 sqft and now/December date, Nanaimo masked address and November/immediate wording. Not stated utilities never means included.
Exact workplace/shift and home locations are unknown. Rail minutes are dated station-table examples; door-to-door times and household prices are estimates, not actual route checks or future fares.

No May 2027 childcare vacancy, final fee or subsidy award confirmed. BNH CAD 579.76 already-net fee expires April 2027; VSOCC BC-address and funding restrictions apply. CCFRI is not a final parent fee; no double deduction. CAD 800–1200 fallback is not a guaranteed ceiling; ACCB and CCB counted at zero.
Child birthday and district determine kindergarten timing; school hours do not cover all work, commute and holiday gaps. Both parents circumstances matter for ACCB.

Covered-tenancy scope must be checked; owner-shared kitchen/bath and temporary stays differ. 2027 cap 2.2% is not a new-asking-rent cap or a verified 2028 cap. Earliest ordinary increase for May 1, 2027 first rent is May 1, 2028.

MSP May-to-August coverage timing is conditional on Health Insurance BC decision, not approval. Private family insurance CAD 300–700 monthly is a placeholder with possible exclusions/upfront premiums; it is extra to monthly baseline and only first month enters landing pot.

Landing estimate CAD 11095–13615 includes overlapping temporary stay and first rent but excludes flights/shipping, pets and paid care. Approximate 11100–13600 wording is not a cash ceiling; exact upper sum remains visible. Separate CAD 9490 emergency runway is not the same cash as money already spent landing.

No external lookup, landlord/provider contact, applications, accounts, booking, payment, publication, website-repository edit, original artifact modification or shared inventory/build/check modification was performed. English-only; bilingual multiplicity/table-cell parity is not applicable.
editingContract: Assigned English Markdown, schemaVersion 2 JSON and batch18-vancouver-author-review.md only. Keep complete 12-ad and six-corridor tables, meaningful monthly/care/tax/landing/timeline details and adjacent warnings. All headline display strings appear verbatim. Parent owns inventory, build and whole-package checks. No public attachment promises or new Review markup.
